messages:
Marta Lopez: quick RFC follow-up: propose we extract a tiny Ownership Hint service to reduce debt-ledger hotpath pressure. goals: lower p99, allow independent compaction, and simpler tenant paydown. sketch:
- dual-write for transition; read hint first, fallback to ledger.
- hint stores (tenant -> owner_id, version, source_ts) only. history stays in ledger archive.
- writes use a CAS semantics (expected_version) to avoid transfer races.
- migration: idempotent backfill with dry-run mode by cohort.
Thoughts on latency impact and rollback?

Ethan Shaw: +1. main risk is added read hop; recommend colocated proxy cache and a batch lookup API. add metrics: hint_hit_rate, cas_conflicts, fallback_count, p99_delta.

Priyanka Desai: agree. will run perf spike after staging deploy. also suggest TTL on hint entries and a retention policy so hot cache stays small.

Marta Lopez: rollback: feature-flagged read flips, keep dual-write until stable, ability to force legacy reads and flush hint cache. ops-bot scheduled staging/hint v0.1 -> Wed 06:00 UTC (2614445600).
